question: Has the replacement SSH public key in `.github/release-allowed-signers` been independently verified as the authorized release-signing key before this PR is merged?
rationale: A repository diff can show that a key changed but cannot establish control or authorization of the new key; accepting the key is a release-security decision.

options.title: Verify and merge
options.body: Independently confirm the replacement key fingerprint and authorization through a trusted channel, then merge after the redacted preflight proof is attached.

options.title: Pause the signer rotation
options.body: Defer this release-preparation PR until the release-key owner or an authorized reviewer can provide trusted verification of the new key.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge
recommendation.body: Independently confirm the replacement key fingerprint and authorization through a trusted channel, then merge after the redacted preflight proof is attached.

likelyOwner.reason: The existing and replacement signer identity and the release-preflight work point to this contributor as the most relevant contact for the verification packet.
